title: Which Sandwich?
description: About Sandwiches, like lots of sandwiches, 7 sandwiches.
body:
🥪 Which Sandwich

A simple and tasty food mod that adds a whole new menu of sandwiches to Minecraft!

Which Sandwich adds a variety of sandwiches, ingredients, and one decorative block.
Whether you want a fresh Apple Sandwich, a veggie snack, or even a Cod Sandwich, there’s always something to eat on your adventures.

Made using MCreator, so expect it to be bad.

🍞 ✨ Features
🥪 New Sandwiches

Apple Sandwich

Beetroot Sandwich

Carrot Sandwich

Cod Sandwich

Potato Sandwich

Tomato Sandwich

Everyday Sandwich

🧀 New Ingredients

Cheese

Salt

Ketchup

Tomato

Tomato Bottle

Craft them, eat them, or use them to trade.

🧱 New Block

Sandwich Block — a decorative block for kitchens or food-themed builds.

🤝 Villager Trades

Some villagers offer sandwiches or ingredients in exchange for emeralds.

📜 Advancements

Two custom advancements for crafting and trying out sandwiches.

🎒 Creative Tabs

All items and blocks organized into custom creative tabs for easy access.

⚙️ Compatibility

NeoForge 1.21.8

Works in survival, multiplayer, and modpacks

Lightweight & performance-friendly

🍽️ Why This Mod?

Which Sandwich is a small, fun, and lightweight food expansion made for players who want more variety without adding complicated machines or systems. Every sandwich is simple to craft, fits naturally into Minecraft’s style, and gives your world a bit more flavor and creativity.
